prerequisites: Enrolment in the Bachelor's degree program IT-Security at RUB or admitted as a secondary student
Not currently in a similar examination procedure at another university and has not definitively passed or failed a similar examination
Successfully completed modules totaling at least 135 LP
Successfully passed all compulsory modules up to and including the 4th semester according to the study plan in the annex of the examination regulations

learning_outcomes.text: The Bachelor's thesis should demonstrate that the student is able to independently process a demanding computer science problem within a given deadline, applying the methods acquired during their Bachelor's studies.
Acquisition of basic knowledge of scientific work, including project organization, and presentation of the results.
In-depth knowledge in the area of the task processed.

syllabus_topics: Processing and solving a scientific task in the field of computer science under supervision within a period of 3 months. The knowledge, competencies, and methods acquired during the Bachelor's degree should be applied. The results of the work are to be written down.
Presentation of the results in the form of a colloquium lecture following the completion of the Bachelor's thesis.
assessment_rules: Both the Bachelor's thesis and the colloquium presentation must be passed. The respective partial grades are included in the module grade weighted by the ECTS credits.
